description: This source file defines a custom authentication provider for Spring Security, extending DaoAuthenticationProvider. It performs additional checks for user lock status before proceeding with authentication, using a UserService to manage user state.

classes.name: CustomAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A custom authentication provider that extends Spring Security's DaoAuthenticationProvider to add user lock status checks during authentication.
